summary: PrometheusDeploy 185b64f on phase/028-P3: while no app is scraped, each standing Argo CD alert now keeps its own ALERTS state (pending or firing, bounded 20 m after its app's last scrape) instead of replaying the last 20 m of SyncError/Degraded samples, so a gap after recovery and a deleted app stay quiet (F1, witnessed red on the old rules), and test 2 now pins the degraded alert's 20 m lapse and pending clock (F2, the [3m] mutation now fails). kc project test and lint green; 7 mutations of the new hold each go red; the resolve-delay trade-off is close-out Q2.
